shortDescription: Organise daily family care and prepare a clear handover for the next carer.
longDescription: Keep daily tasks, appointments, medication reminders and care notes in one place. Review what happened since the last visit, add follow-up actions and save a caregiver handover. The next caregiver can record an acknowledgement on the same device. Local care planning works without an account. Medication status is recorded only when a user confirms it.
releaseNotes: First release with daily planning, care journals and handovers on a shared device.
